# Constraints for every `uv pip install` in CI (UV_CONSTRAINT, set in ci.yml).
#
# PySide6 6.12.0 (2026-10) makes the no-GUI test run (`pytest -p no:pytest-qt`)
# crash at interpreter exit on Linux and macOS: every test passes, then
# "QObject: shared QObject was deleted directly" and a segmentation fault
# (exit code 139). 6.11 ends the same run cleanly. Lift this once the teardown
# crash under 6.12 is understood and fixed.
PySide6<6.12
PySide6-Essentials<6.12
PySide6-Addons<6.12
shiboken6<6.12
